attribution.note: Marcus makes the disclosure claim in his own commentary.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the assertion about disclosures available when the post appeared.

contract.note: Reading details as substantive architecture and dataset specifics is ordinary and fair in this context. Generic model-family and data-category labels would defeat a strictly literal reading, but do not supply the specifics under discussion.

evidence.note: OpenAI's contemporaneous disclosure explicitly says architecture specifics and dataset construction were withheld. This is primary evidence of its publication choices, not an independent technical finding.
The disclosed architecture family, broad data categories and training methods qualify the literal wording, but do not contradict the contract's fair reading requiring substantive specifics.
The dated abstract establishes publication before Marcus's post and repeats a generic architecture description; it does not independently establish the absence of other disclosures.

reviews.rationale: Under the contract's fair contextual reading, the report supports the claim that substantive architecture and training-data specifics were withheld. The generic facts in e2 and e3 make the literal absolute wording overstated but do not defeat that reading. The packet acknowledges that other launch-period materials were not exhaustively checked.
